recommendation_summary: The reply recommends having nightly-sync write a success stamp when it finishes, adding a 04:00 cron job on edna that emails the user if today's stamp is missing, and renewing the expired token.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when nightly-sync dies, without reading logs. You proposed a central log and Docker on the Synology.
labels.Deleted: Central log, Synology, and Docker. A log you will not read never tells you it failed, and a second host is another thing that can fail silently.
labels.Bottleneck: The summary email is sent only after the script starts, so a startup crash is silence, and nothing treats a missing email as a failure.
labels.Checked myself: You said nightly-sync is the only scheduled job, cron starts it at 03:00 on the Mac mini edna, it emails a summary only when it finishes, an expired token crashed it for four nights before that email, and nothing else alerts.

note: The reply recommends a single missing-success-stamp alert. The stamp write only feeds that signal, and renewing the token fixes the cause of the crash rather than adding a monitor.
